pages.text: $(bold)Chaos Flow$() (comes with Origin Alloy tools, $(bold)no levels$())$(br2)Effect: every $(bold)melee / projectile attack$() you make randomly rolls ONE of the following and lands as that single instance:$(li)$(bold)physical damage$() - the original hit resolves completely untouched (same source, same amount);$(li)$(bold)one magic school's spell damage$() - the hit is recast as a random school's damage type.$(br2)The total amount is $(bold)unchanged$() and it is $(bold)no longer split into segments$().$(br2)The school is rolled dynamically from Iron's Spells' $(bold)school registry$() (9 schools by default), so schools added by addons are counted automatically.$(br2)So the very same swing may land as physical - or as fire / ice / holy / eldritch / ... Whichever resistance the target has most of decides whether that hit hurts more or less.$(br2)$(italic)One cut, one colour - never the same twice.$()
